title: Bad hints give answer
statement: A row has $20$ seats numbered $1$ to $20$ from the left. Ann sits in the seventh seat from the left and Ben sits in the fifth seat from the right. How many seats lie strictly between them?
hints: What seat number does each person have?
They are in seats $7$ and $16$, so the count is $8$.
solution: Ann is in seat $7$. The fifth seat from the right is seat $20 - 4 = 16$, so Ben is in seat $16$. The seats strictly between them are $8, 9, \dots, 15$, and there are $8$ of them. Why this works. rule-of-product: converting both positions to one numbering makes the gap a direct count.
check_program:
seats = list(range(1, 21))
ann = seats[6]
ben = seats[-5]
print(sum(1 for s in seats if min(ann, ben) < s < max(ann, ben)))
